Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task instructions by considering a reprint edition year (2015 for Catan) instead of sticking to the original release years. This diverted from the task's requirement to use the original publication years to determine which game was published most recently. The Planner prematurely concluded that the most recent major edition indicates the latest publication, leading to a wrong interpretation of the task.
